jobs.prompt:
Write the GitHub PR description for the connectors T16b follow-ups into coordination/connectors-followups-pr.md. Inputs: coordination/connectors-followups-pr-input.md and coordination/connectors-followups-changelog.md (use only the newest entry). Plain words, short sentences. Sections: Summary (one bullet each for d, e, f, plus the version 0.3.1), Why (one line: found in the live Mac run), Tests (paste the check block verbatim), Open for Braden (whether to re-vendor 0.3.1 into agent-core later). Do not invent facts. Do not claim any ticket is done. End the file with the line: 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Only edit the declared output. End with one JSON line {"files_changed":[...]}.
